name: loan-collection-platform
description: Bank loan collection calling platform with simulated outbound calls

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:railway: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
